verdict.rationale: Slack's first-party pages describe in-product AI insights over workspace data. These include the 'Today' briefing that signals what needs attention, a Slackbot agent that analyzes reports and digs into open-ended questions, channel and thread summaries with daily recaps, and huddle notes with key takeaways and action items. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these insights work as claimed, and in-depth documentation (the evidence is marketing-level) of how suggestions are generated and which data sources they draw on.
